Warframe is a highly addictive grind-heavy sci-fi space ninja co-op game.


 + The community is awesome.
 + The devs listen to player feedback.
 + It's not at all pay-to-win, prime access cosmetics can only be bought with real money but everything else can be acquired by playing/trading.
 + The game is getting frequent updates.
 + It has awesome graphics, art style and sound.
 + You can kill robots with swords.
 + It is fast.
 + It is great with friends.
 + It features a wide variety of weapons and suits.

 - The f2p model is very aggresive (time walls, RNG walls, grind walls).
 - The new player experience sucks.
 - It is quite empty lore-wise. There is no real story and meaning to what you do in Warframe, it is mostly just a farming/collecting game atm.


Try it, it is free. If the grind does not dissuade you, Warframe can keep you entertained for hundreds of hours.
The game is about some cyber type ninjas fighting etc, it's a good free to play.

This game, though generic in the vast sea of shooters out there, is an absolute gem. It's like Destiny without the payout and disappointing hype, which makes for an actually good game. Granted, its complex parkour system takes some getting used to, the game's combat is fluid and beautiful. 

Pros:::
+ Graphical Engine Improved
+ Smooth Framerates, even on entry-level PC rigs
+ Fluid Combat and Parkour System
+ Dynamic and intriguing lore and fluff

Cons::: 
- Lacks true narrative
- Without help from Clan guys or experienced players, prepare to be a member of Scrub City
- Generally poor storytelling in terms of the "storyline" itself

8/10, because I wish Lotus was just *better*
